## 22. GFR,, Procurement and Government e-Marketplace  
[ Swamy's General Financial Rules, Manual for Procurement of Goods and Manual for Procurement of Consultancy and Services]  
The general rules applicable to all Ministries or Departments, regarding procurement of goods and services required for use in the public service are governed by Rules 142 to 206 of General Financial Rules.
